payload.title: Cross-implementation conformance suite
payload.description: Language-neutral conformance harness: (1) golden wire fixtures for every frame type, error envelope, and schema-identity case; (2) black-box scenario tests (connect, auth, object sync, stream replay, presence, signals, projections, jobs, blobs, grants, multi-node via cluster bus) runnable against an arbitrary server URL. CI runs it against BOTH the TS and Rust servers until cutover. This is the acceptance gate for the big-bang switch.
